symptom: A PR created successfully in a transferred repository remains undiscovered because the REST head filter retains the old owner. Similar branch names and bounded closed-PR history also misidentify or hide PRs.
rule: Resolve canonical repository identity before qualifying the head, validate the stable head repository ID, search open PRs first, and reconcile recorded PRs by number. See git show 7b6eb9e6:agents/zstack/changes/github-pr-discovery-identity.md.
